Job Summary

We are seeking an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to design develop and deploy autonomous AI systems powered by Large Language Models LLMs AI Agents MultiAgent Frameworks and Generative AI technologies The ideal candidate will be responsible for building intelligent agents capable of reasoning planning tool utilization workflow orchestration decisionmaking and autonomous execution of complex business processes

AI Agent Development

Design and develop AI Agents capable of autonomous task execution and decisionmaking

Build singleagent and multiagent systems for enterprise business use cases

Develop agent orchestration frameworks memory architectures and planning mechanisms

Implement toolcalling functioncalling and API integration capabilities for AI agents

Design agent workflows for customer support knowledge management automation and business operations

LLM  Generative AI Engineering

Integrate and optimize Large Language Models GPT Claude Gemini Llama Mistral etc

Develop RetrievalAugmented Generation RAG solutions using enterprise knowledge repositories

Build prompt engineering frameworks and guardrails for safe AI deployments

Finetune and evaluate LLM performance for domainspecific use cases

Implement conversational AI and intelligent assistants

AI Platform  MLOps

Design scalable AI architectures for production deployment

Build CICD and MLOps pipelines for AI models and agent lifecycle management

Monitor agent performance hallucinations accuracy latency and operational metrics

Implement model governance security compliance and responsible AI practices

Support cloudnative deployment of AI workloads

Enterprise Integration

Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications such as Salesforce SAP ServiceNow Microsoft 365 CRM ERP and custom applications

Develop APIbased integrations and workflow automation capabilities

Connect AI agents to structured and unstructured data sources
